name: Guangzhou Pearl River Piano Group Co.,Ltd
summary: Guangzhou Pearl River Piano Group Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, manufacturing, sales and service of piano and digital musical instrument products in China and internationally. The company offers pianos, violins, digital pianos, strings, guitars, and wind instruments and folk music, as well as musical instrument accessories and music culture teaching materials. It is also involved in the art education and cultural media; radio, television, film and video recording production; house and venue rental and leasing; property management; and trading businesses.
